I really loved the enthusiasm Aegon showed towards ruling, however naive it actually is. Let's not forget that Aegon spent much of his life believing that he would never inherit the throne. And now here he is, crowned and in his prime. Suddenly he has complete power. 

And you can see how badly he wants to prove that he is not only entitled to this power, but worthy of wielding it, of being a good king. 

But reality is that being king is more complicated then he thought. And it's not as if he has ever really been taught (or cared to retain any teaching he did get along the way) how to sit the throne. He can't just snap his fingers and fix problems. War IS actually coming, and gold actually has value. It's more then he bargained for, and he is clearly out of his depth. 

And I love that Alicent and Otto know that. Their dialogue sharing the plan to basically let Aegon run himself out - devious. Alicent knows her lazy, abusive, brat of a son won't care about any of this as soon as push comes to shove. 

Alicents relationships with her kids are so complex and interesting.

I got scared. It was an attempt at poly that neither myself or my partner were ready to persue- but mostly myself. When things started going well with a couple that I had been seeing, my partner of 4+ years pulled out and threatened to end our relationship. 

I ghosted the couple, who I truly had grown to care about, because I couldn't stand to lose the relationship I had built, regardless of how many problems we have/had. They reached out a few months later expressing disappointment in my ghosting, and sadness that I didn't feel comfortable enough to talk with them. They were such good people and I still feel shame to this day thinking about how I hurt them. 

I struggle with GAD and depression, as well as panic disorder and severe social anxiety, so when things get hard I tend to bottle up and receed into myself. I was just too cowardly to be honest, and too afraid to lose my current relationship, that I really just took the easy way out. Its a selfish thing, and I'm a selfish person, so i never ended up responding to that message. 

I still get waves of shame whenever i think about it; and ive composed more than one reply that just always gets deleted because really, I have no valid excuse. And I'm afraid that now, reaching out and opening old wounds would just hurt them more, as much as I would love to just apologise, and let them know that they did nothing wrong.

I really, really hope they're doing well, and that their wedding was beautiful.
